detail: The hotel identifies the 1891 Main with its Western base geometry, symmetrical octagonal bays and Japanese gabled porch. It documents the near-original 1906 cottages, 1930 Dining Room and tower, 1936 Flower Palace and Forest Wing.
The Japanese account records the Main’s karahafu portal, octagonal front projections, Flower Palace castle-style gables and balcony, and the Dining Room’s copper gable roofs and pagoda-like tower.
The operator’s renovation report identifies preservation of the Main, Dining Room, western cottages and Flower Palace, the updated Forest Wing, and replacement service facilities as the Cascade Wing.
Conservation architects document survey and restoration design for the Main, 1906 first cottage, 1930 Dining Room and 1936 Flower Palace.
The hotel describes prominent vermilion balcony rails and multiple gables of the Flower Palace.
